gloss: even so; nevertheless; be that as it may

definitions.gloss: even so; nevertheless; be that as it may
definitions.explanation: acknowledges a previous point while introducing a contrasting or surprising observation

examples.japanese: それにしても⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: It really is hot, though, isn't it?

examples.japanese: それにしても{遅|おそ}すぎる。
examples.english: Still, this is far too late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、それにしても⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧くらい⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧だろう。
examples.english: I understand you're busy, but even so, you could at least get in touch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{聞|き}いていた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、それにしても⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧だ。
examples.english: I'd heard it was cheap, but even so, this price is surprising.

notes:
USAGE:
Opens a sentence. It grants what was said (or what is understood) and then insists that what follows is still striking: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧のは⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、それにしても… (I know you're busy, but even so…).

In conversation it also opens a remark with no stated premise, as a sigh of emphasis or a gentle change of topic: それにしても⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ (It really is hot, though, isn't it?). English "even so" does not fit this use.
